title: Q-PROMO-indexnow: keep the indexnow promotion channel live
body:
**Owner:** marketing-manager
**Trigger:** every promote --plan pass
**Done check:** grep:ops/promotion/outcomes.jsonl::"channel": "indexnow"
**Prediction:** promotion_outcomes_recorded >= 1 within 336 h
**Status:** closed

Route: site/worker.js /api/v1/promote/indexnow (tick and deploy). Signal back: search referrals in first-party hits. Record the result with `python3 -m foundation promote --outcome indexnow --kind listed|silent`; the outcome re-weights the channel.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 169.6 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
